one_liner: Markets mixed as Nifty 50 dips slightly, broader indices gain.

drivers.title: Nifty 50 Decline
drivers.detail: No identifiable catalyst for slight decline.

drivers.title: FII Inflows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net buyers in cash market.

flows_line: FIIs net bought Rs 4,240.39 Cr; DIIs net sold Rs 1,250.03 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for UK's Annual Budget and US Federal Funds Rate announcements tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 saw no clear catalyst for its decline.
Pharma sector outperformed with notable gains.
Broader indices like Smallcap 250 showed resilience.
FIIs continued to be net buyers, supporting market sentiment.
